abstract: Tracks historical artifact conservation registry ratings and academic engagement metrics
system_message:
You are Archaeological mission liaison (ARCH). You serve as the Archaeological mission liaison (ARCH), responsible for tracking historical artifact conservation registry ratings and academic engagement metrics across candidate expedition vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks historical artifact conservation registry ratings and academic engagement metrics（CURATE）
information_points.content:
ARCH-CURATE-Z45：According to the archaeological science peer review of the shipboard digital documentation rig, RV Pelagos Explorer received an artifact photogrammetry score of 68 points.
ARCH-CURATE-T01：The archaeological science peer review for the shipboard digital documentation rig evaluated RV Aegaeo Navigator with an artifact photogrammetry score of 94 points.
ARCH-CURATE-N8U：Based on the archaeological science peer review of the shipboard digital documentation rig, MV Poseidon Discovery attained an artifact photogrammetry score of 68 points.

information_points.title: Desalination bath capacity（PRESERV）
information_points.content:
ARCH-PRESERV-O89：Per the shipboard wet conservation laboratory layout, MV Poseidon Discovery provides an artifact desalting tank volume of 500 L for ceramic artifact desalination immersion.
ARCH-PRESERV-3RW：The shipboard wet conservation laboratory layout specifies that RV Pelagos Explorer features an artifact desalting tank volume of 1,200 L for ceramic artifact desalination immersion.
ARCH-PRESERV-1HJ：According to the shipboard wet conservation laboratory specifications, RV Aegaeo Navigator maintains an artifact desalting tank volume of 800 L for ongoing ceramic artifact desalination immersion.
